svg.title: Multi-tenant SaaS: pooled and silo tiers
svg.desc: One codebase and one pipeline serve every tenant. The tier in the token decides where a request runs: shared infrastructure for Starter and Pro, a dedicated account for Enterprise.

text.tspan: Starter + Pro share compute and one database
Enterprise tenants get their own AWS account
Pooled tenants are cheap to serve; silo tenants buy isolation and their own
keys. The control plane stays single, so onboarding, billing and identity
